instruction: Open https://www.prothomalo.com/. Open the site search (খুঁজুন) and search for ইলিশ. On the search page (অনুসন্ধান), set the সেকশন filter to বাণিজ্য, set the ধরন filter to টেক্সট, and set সাজানো to নতুন থেকে পুরোনো. The evaluated endpoint is the correctly configured search request; nothing needs to be submitted or saved.
